mcp_tools.name: agent_context_packaging
mcp_tools.title: Agent context packaging
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared agent context-pack manifest; get a deterministic PACK_SOUND / PACK_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections (scope declaration, redaction, structure and manifest, reproducibility and signing, handoff dossier, freshness and privacy) with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The agent context-pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

freshness.description: Freshness evidence (declared dates/review dates; presence only, never clock-compared).

privacy.description: Privacy evidence (lawful basis gated on declared third-party personal data).

expect.notes: All boolean requirements met; red-line constraints (contacts_or_financials_included=false, secrets_or_pii_unredacted_present=false, hand_assembled=false, derived_pack_hand_maintained_silently=false) satisfied.
